5 تشوّق He was, or became, excited by desire, or yearning or longing of the soul; quasi-pass. of شَوَّقَهُ (S, TA) and شَاقَهُ. (TA.) See also 8. ―
-b2- And (TA) He showed, or made a show of, (O, K, TA,) and affected, (O,) or affecting, (K, TA,) desire, or a yearning or longing of the soul. (O, K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
